newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia 637-day bond tranche priced at 95.63 pct. [CORRECTED 16:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Russia 637-day bond tranche priced at 95.63 pct. [CORRECTED 16:50 GMT]

text.p: The average price of a 637-day tranche of an existing series of two-year OFZ (corrects from 679-day OFZ) interest-bearing bonds (series 24009) was 95.63 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the cventral bank said.
An earlier tranche of the 24009 bonds closed on Tuesday at 96.00 percent. A tranche of the series 24009 bonds was sold on December 11 at an average price of 94.02 percent.
(Corrects from "When the series 24009 bonds were first sold on December 11, the average price was 94.02 percent.")
Issue volume 3.00 trln roubles 3.00 trln rbls

The Finance Ministry said earlier this month it would pay 78,385 roubles, equivalent to an annual rate of 31.44 percent, in quarterly interest on series 24009 bonds in April. The January 22 coupon payment is 106,657 roubles, or 42.78 percent.
